This issue's symptom is not a single `dxc` invocation, so there is no `cmd.txt`
in the standard "arguments only, one dxc invocation per line" form. Recorded
here for reference; see `measure-rewrite.py` for the actual harness that
issues this call.

Tool under test: `dxr` (the `IDxcRewriter2::RewriteWithOptions` COM entry
point embedded in `dxcompiler.dll`; there is no Debug `dxr.exe` in this build
tree, and no shipped release archive contains one either — see
`method-notes.md`).

Reporter's exact command line, reproduced verbatim:

    dxr.exe -remove-unused-functions -remove-unused-globals -E ps_main repro.hlsl

`measure-rewrite.py` replicates this exactly via ctypes/COM against a given
`dxcompiler.dll` (ground truth or any cached release), passing this same argv
(program name included, matching `dxr.cpp`'s own `skipArgCount=0` convention)
straight into `RewriteWithOptions`.

Usage:

    python measure-rewrite.py --shader repro.hlsl               # ground truth only
    python measure-rewrite.py --shader repro.hlsl --dll <path>   # a specific dxcompiler.dll
    python measure-rewrite.py --history                          # repro.hlsl x every cached release + main-debug
    python measure-rewrite.py --shader <file> --label <name> --expect match|no-match
        # files a variant-<name>-main-debug.txt capture, scored with
        # match.json via triage.classify, so `triage.py audit`/`reindex`
        # see it exactly like a `run --label` capture (see notes.md).
